title: Uka Jardin uñjirinaka
intro: Mä suma jardinanjja, mä comunidadaw mä jachʼa juramento lurapjjäna. Ukampis Diosan munañapajj ukar yanaptʼkäna ukhajj yantʼatänwa, ukat walja qollqenïpjjatapajj mä jan wawan oraqer tukuyäna.
clues: Mä jachʼa jardinaniw bendicionanak katoqapjjta, ukampis jachʼa jachʼa tukupjjayätwa.
Mä amtar puripxta, pisinkirinakamp jan chikachasisax yapu apthapiñatakiwa.
Wali alwat sartasipjjayäta, kuna amtampitï amtapkta ukar jan ajjsarasaw sarapjjta.
Ukampis puripkta ukhajja, mä arumajj jardinajajj tʼunjatäjjänwa.
Pantjasitaj amuyasisaw maynit maynikam juchañchasiñ qalltapjjta.
Qhepatjja arrepentisipjjayätwa, ukampis uka yatichäwijj wali qhepatwa yateqapjjta.

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
